about_the_game:
When the old world broke, the sea claimed the land — and only fragments of humanity survived.

Landoff — Afterworld  is not just another survival game. It’s the beginning of a story where every step, every choice, and every risk matters.

Welcome to the world of Landoff
Survive the Cataclysm and explore a living, breathing world scattered across the remnants of civilization. Every island is like a living organism, fighting to endure in a shattered oceanic realm.

Heart of Survival
Your boat is your home, your trade hub, and your lifeline. Keep it fueled, repair it, and protect it from the elements. Without fuel, a sudden storm could trap you in the open sea with no way back.

The Underwater
Equip a diving suit and explore the ocean floor in search of treasures to sell or trade. Without proper gear, every dive is a deadly gamble — and losing your boat means losing everything you own.

Hunting, Fishing, and Cooking
Hunt wild animals, catch fish, and cook your food directly in your hands over an open flame. Meals grant temporary buffs — from instant healing to improved stamina — and every bite could decide your fate in battle.

Trade
Manage all your resources through your boat: fuel, diving gear, and goods for resale. Trade, upgrade your vessel, purchase equipment, and develop skills to survive harsher challenges.

Monsters and Quests
Face dangerous enemies, complete quest chains, and make decisions that shape the fate of the islands. Every encounter is a risk — and every victory, a step forward.

A Unique Save System
No traditional saves. You live your character’s life without rewinds. Save only on islands or in motels — if you can find one. Run out of fuel in the middle of a storm, and your journey may end forever.

World
Navigate using lighthouses and buoys at night. Each lighthouse signals territorial waters, greeting you and wishing safe travels. Powered by Unity 6 HDRP, Landoff delivers stunning realism, dynamic physics, and a truly immersive survival experience.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of violence, blood, and scenes involving alcohol consumption.
Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K, AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K или AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Landoff is an open-world survival adventure set among scattered islands after a global cataclysm. Explore vast seas, gather resources, build, trade, and fight for survival. Experience dynamic weather, meaningful choices, and the mystery of a world torn apart.
